# Sestrian

> A blockchain whose state is the weights of a single public neural network. A
> block is one optimizer step, a transaction is a signed gradient update, and
> replaying the chain reconstructs the model bit-for-bit. No one owns the model;
> the protocol pays the people who train it and the people who supply the data
> it trains on.

Sestrian inverts the usual decentralized-AI arrangement. Other networks keep the
incentive layer on-chain and the model in someone's storage bucket. Here the
model's weights ARE the chain state, so the model is exactly as auditable as the
ledger, and "who contributed what" is a consensus fact rather than a claim.

Status: an open devnet. Treat rewards as testnet play — the chain has reset more
than once while the protocol moved, and it may again.

## How it works

- One living model. The chain's state is a growable Mixture-of-Experts
  transformer, currently 107.4M parameters (~32M active per token). The network
  can vote to add expert pages, so the model grows on-chain.
- Mining is training. A miner trains on data it has staked, and submits the
  integer-quantized gradient delta. Rewards are weighted by the delta's measured
  improvement on a held-out batch, not by hardware spent.
- Cross-vendor determinism. Floating-point math differs between Apple and NVIDIA
  chips, so every update is quantized to integers before it touches the chain.
  Integers do not disagree. A MacBook and an NVIDIA box in different buildings
  land on the same state root, bit for bit.
- Enforced provenance. Every delta must name the staked corpora it trained on. A
  delta with unbacked provenance is rejected outright, not merely unpaid.
- Data availability. A staked corpus commits to a Merkle root over its
  erasure-coded 4 MiB chunks, so anyone can sample it and prove the bytes still
  exist rather than trusting that they do.

## Verify rather than trust

- Genesis id (state root): 91bdcc281c0dbbd7b3bea3d38003e4c61565bcaa5fd8e7bfca296e6a4994ddb1
- The genesis is deterministic from (model, seed), so anyone can reproduce it
  locally and confirm the id instead of downloading and hoping.
- The Rust node is pinned to a Python reference implementation by golden vectors
  covering 30 families; the reference is the spec, and a divergence fails CI.

## Run a node

- Watch and serve: `npx sestrian run` — downloads a hash-verified binary, makes
  a wallet, fetches the genesis, joins the network. No compiler, no Python.
- Mine (needs a GPU and the PyTorch trainer): clone the repo and run
  `scripts/install.sh --mine`.

## What is not done

Stated plainly, because an answer that repeats marketing copy is worse than no
answer. Delta-score committees and cross-inclusion challenges need independent
operators and wait on a multi-operator testnet. Large-corpus DA ingestion for
multi-gigabyte third-party datasets is still being built out. Availability
challenges currently resolve by juror vote rather than by proof. This is an
early-stage project running an open devnet, not a finished network.
